MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 7

2. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 15
   C. 7
   D. 17

4. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

5. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 10

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 156

7. Solve for x: x + 4 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 6
   D. 7

8. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

9. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 11
   C. 28
   D. 29

10. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 5
   C. 36
   D. 13

11. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 90

13. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 65
   D. 64

14. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

15. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 169

16. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 9
   C. 1
   D. 21

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

2. Substitute values: 7² = 7 × 7
3. 7² = 49
Final Answer: 49
